sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def pegs_top(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # R1 rows 15-18, cells C0-C6 centers col 7,13,19,25,31,37,43
    cols=[7,13,19,25,31,37,43]
    r=[16,17]
    out=[]
    for gc,ct in enumerate(cols):
        if any(a[rr][ct+dc]=='N' for rr in r for dc in range(3)):
            out.append(gc)
    return out
def pegs_bottom(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # bottom box 2x2: cells at (45,43),(45,49),(51,43),(51,49)
    cells=[(46,44),(46,50),(52,44),(52,50)]
    out=[]
    for (rr,ct) in cells:
        if a[rr][ct]=='N': out.append((rr,ct))
    return out
print("top before:", pegs_top(current_frame), "bottom before:", pegs_bottom(current_frame))
# jump C1 -> C3 (target at col 26, row 16)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':26}])
print("top after:", pegs_top(current_frame), "bottom after:", pegs_bottom(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def pegs_top(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # R1 rows 15-18, cells C0-C6 centers col 7,13,19,25,31,37,43
    cols=[7,13,19,25,31,37,43]
    r=[16,17]
    out=[]
    for gc,ct in enumerate(cols):
        if any(a[rr][ct+dc]=='N' for rr in r for dc in range(3)):
            out.append(gc)
    return out
def pegs_bottom(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # bottom box 2x2: cells at (45,43),(45,49),(51,43),(51,49)
    cells=[(46,44),(46,50),(52,44),(52,50)]
    out=[]
    for (rr,ct) in cells:
        if a[rr][ct]=='N': out.append((rr,ct))
    return out
print("top before:", pegs_top(current_frame), "bottom before:", pegs_bottom(current_frame))
# jump C1 -> C3 (target at col 26, row 16)

print("top after:", pegs_top(current_frame), "bottom after:", pegs_bottom(current_frame))
